newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mixed after moving tightly.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed after moving tightly.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Market was lower as prices consolidated throughout the day on lack of fresh developments. Nov 1-25 palm oil exports by SGS (M) Sdn Bhd had no impact. Prices are expected to drift sideways slightly above the 1,200 levels in near-term unless fresh news appear.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also followed the futures market with interest confining to nearby CPOs.
Turnover on the futures market fell further to 644 lots from 970 lots on Friday.
Among physical, Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,215 ringgit with bids at 1,207.50 after trading at 1,210, and Nov (central) at 1,205 against 1,195.
Dec (south) saw offers at 1,222.50 ringgit and bids at 1,215 and earlier trades were 1,225 to 1,217.50, and Dec (central) was at 1,212.50 against 1,200.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $520 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $517.50. Dec was traded at $517.50.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $557.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $550.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $377.50 and Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5235 ringgit)
